title: 3827. Count Monobit Integers

examples.explanation: The integers in the range [0, 1] have binary representations "0" and "1". Each representation consists of identical bits. Thus, the answer is 2.
The integers in the range [0, 4] include binaries "0", "1", "10", "11", and "100". Only 0, 1 and 3 satisfy the Monobit condition. Thus, the answer is 3.
